exchangers), this can add cost. This matters substantially for more efficient 
ground-source heat pumps, where installation can take up to several weeks and 
requires drilling and underground piping, making their total cost much higher than 
other options. Installation time and costs could decline as heat pumps become 
more common, and offer greater opportunities than in manufacturing. The most 
expensive components in heat pumps (e.g. heat exchangers, compressors) have 
already been mass manufactured for a long time, making further manufacturing 
cost reductions more limited than for other clean energy technologies.
